Name: Modern Wind Mill
Author: monteso
Description:
WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE


With the new 1.1 update, it introduced Flour mills. And frankly it looks goofy. So I dug into the file and replace it with a modern Halladay Steel Windmill. Comes in red trim, but can add different colors if requested.

[u][b]Install info[/b][/u]
Drag mill.xnb into Content/Buildings folder, and overwrite.

[u][b]Optional Files[/b][/u]
Alternate file to get rid of the grinding house underneath the Mill. Can still process wheat/beets. Building shadow still present, can't fix.
